gaps.construct: this._events === ObjectGetPrototypeOf(this)._events (reference identity: is the events object shared with the prototype)
gaps.description: Scribe has value comparison only; there is no notion of two names referring to the same object. Invented `is the same object as`.

gaps.construct: Prototype inheritance: ObjectGetPrototypeOf(this), EventEmitter.prototype[kCapture], function invoked with `this` bound to a subclass instance
gaps.description: No inheritance, prototypes or methods. `this` becomes an editable parameter and the prototype lookup an invented operation `prototype_of`.

gaps.construct: EventEmitter.prototype[kCapture] is module-level mutable state set by EventEmitter.captureRejections
gaps.description: No module state; modelled as a field of a passed-in EmitterDefaults capability, which changes every caller's signature.

gaps.construct: { __proto__: null } dictionary from event name to listeners
gaps.description: The doc has List only; no Map/Dictionary type or empty-map literal. Invented `a Map from EventKey to Listeners` and `an empty Map using memory`.
Computed/symbol property keys have no equivalent; modelled as ordinary named fields, losing their privacy from other modules.

gaps.construct: opts.captureRejections may be any JS value, checked at run time by validateBoolean; JS truthiness of opts?.captureRejections
gaps.description: No dynamic/unknown type and no truthiness. Invented `Unknown` and an `is_truthy` helper; the run-time type check becomes a call that can fail.

gaps.construct: undefined fields, optional chaining opts?.x, and `this._maxListeners ||= undefined`
gaps.description: Expressible with `maybe` and nested `choose`, but each `?.` becomes a nested choose block with no-op arms; `||=` over all falsy values (0, NaN, null) cannot be reproduced exactly with a typed field.
choose must be exhaustive and the doc shows no empty-arm form, so dummy assignments were written in `when nothing` arms.
No optional parameters; caller must pass `nothing` explicitly.

gaps.construct: Boolean type, true/false literals, Boolean(x) conversion
gaps.description: The doc never names a boolean type or literals; invented `Bool`, `true`, `false`.
No type annotation on var, so the type of a variable initialised to `nothing` is not stated anywhere the doc defines.
Doc requires an Allocator for any allocation; a JS constructor helper allocating a fresh object now needs a memory capability and an OutOfMemory failure the original does not have.

invented_syntax: maybe as the type of a field (`field ... as a maybe Number`) is shown in the schema example only; used in a type
notes: The whole point of this function is JavaScript object-model machinery (prototype identity, symbol keys, truthiness, optional properties), none of which Scribe has; the translation preserves intent but not semantics. Optional chaining is the most painful ergonomic gap: one `?.` becomes a nested choose with dummy arms, roughly tripling the line count.
